key_points: Intel reported Q2 revenue growth strongest in 15 years and Q3 outlook surpassed estimates, triggering a 12% after-hours rally.
Erste Group Bank raised Intel's EPS estimate, indicating improving profitability outlook.
NorthCrest Asset Management increased its stake in Intel, while Vertrix Wealth and Consolidated Capital reduced positions, showing mixed institutional sentiment.
Pluang notes the stock is down 20% from its September high, testing $100 support amid foundry losses and a cautious outlook.
Sector-wide concerns about AI funding and China competition persist, but Intel's new AI GPU card targets existing data centers to compete with Nvidia.
